title: Biblical Books Metadata
description: Mapping of book node IDs to metadata including canonical name, abbreviation, word count, and chapter node mappings.

abbrev.description: Standard 3-6 letter book abbreviation (e.g. Gen, Matt, 1Sam).

node.description: Unique Text-Fabric or corpus node ID for the book.

words.description: Total word count in this book.

chapters.description: Mapping of chapter node IDs to chapter label strings (e.g. '1', '2', 'Prol').
